Description: LAN browser name. Use one line without double quotes or backslashes. Restart the server after changing settings.
Applies to every map in the rotation unless you explicitly add gametype tokens to Map Rotation. CoD2 uses tdm, not the newer CoD war identifier.

Single-line CoD2 rotation, for example: map mp_toujane map mp_carentan. The first entry starts on launch. Use installed map identifiers only; no double quotes, backslashes, newlines or semicolons. Optional gametype tokens override Game Mode for subsequent maps.
DefaultValue: map mp_toujane map mp_carentan map mp_burgundy map mp_dawnville

Description: Empty allows joining without a password. Use one line without double quotes, backslashes or semicolons. Stored in the instance's generated main/lancon.cfg; keep that file private.
